notes.title: 1.5 Patch Note
notes.content:
Hello,

It's Team Samoyed.

It's been a long time since we last greeted you, as content updates for Teamfight Manager were concluded with the 1.4 patch.

We decided to proceed with this update due to an interesting idea: wouldn't it be fun to apply the recently popular "Fearless Ban&Pick System" to Teamfight Manager?

Although this isn't a large-scale update, we believe the play experience with the Fearless Ban&Pick System will be quite novel.

We hope this update will bring new enjoyment to your gameplay, Managers.

[h3]New Feature[/h3]

[list]
[*] The Fearless Ban&Pick System has been added. It can be configured through New Game+.
[/list]

[h3]Bug Fixes[/h3]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where the popup wouldn't disappear after pressing the attend button during the awards ceremony.

[*] Partially fixed a bug where the cloud save feature wasn't working properly in certain situations.
[/list]

If you find any bugs during gameplay, please don't hesitate to report them to
teamsamoyed@gmail.com
We will fix any discovered bugs as quickly as possible.
Thank you.

notes.title: 1.4 Patch Note
notes.content:
Hello,
It's Team Samoyed.
Before the 1.4 Patch Note, we would like to inform you that this patch will be our last content update. Furthermore, we would like to explain about some of the changes in the roadmap, which was announced with the launch of the game.
The 1.4 Patch update brings us to an end of the Teamfight Manager development and we intend to start working on a next project. Although there will be no more new contents, if there are any inconveniences in your game experience due to bugs, etc., please contact us at [teamsamoyed@gmail.com] and we will do our best to fix.

[h2]Regarding the Workshop and Trade Market[/h2]

As was announced in the Development Roadmap, we have put a lot of thought into the possibility of implementing the Workshop and Trade Market features. Regrettably, we have come to the following conclusions. In case of the Workshop, difficulty level of implementation has increased significantly due to the introduction of the multiplayer mode with the 1.3 Patch update. In case of the Trade Market, the implementation would lead to a collapse of the game system which was initially designed in a way that was not supposed to utilize IP rights of the real league and players.
As the saying goes, 'A good beginning is half the battle.' To most, the saying encourages them to take up on new challenges and just begin with them. However, for us the saying comes closer to heart with a meaning that decisions made in that good beginning carry a lot of weight. Teamfight Manager was initially developed without the Workshop in mind, which made the implementation of the Workshop later on in the development very difficult. Definitely, a lot of our users anticipated these features and we are positive that these features could have added a whole new level of fun. Nonetheless, it pains us to move on to our next project without being able to implement these features.
As our first game, Teamfight Manager was bound to have its drawbacks. But we hope to make the most out of what we have learned from creating Teamfight Manager and we will do our best to create something better in our next project. We had a ton of fun and enjoyed every bit of the game development, all thanks to Teamfight Manager users who had fun playing the game. We look forward to returning once again, a little bit better and a little bit more fun.

[h2]New contents[/h2]

- New champions added: 5 new champions added.
[list]
[*]     Werewolf
[*]     Taoist
[*]     Mystic Dancer
[*]     Dark Mage
[*]     Cold Corpse
[/list]

- Meta-analysis report feature added. The report will be created in a message box throughout the season, where you can check out mainstream champions, counter champions and combos

- Training report feature added. The report will be created according to players' improvements

- News report feature added. News will be created according to player’s circumstances.

- Gift feature added. You will be able to receive gifts from fans.

- Event Match feature added. You can enjoy special matches that can be played during World Championship period after the end of a regular season. You can build your players by participating in these matches. There are 10 types of event matches and every season you will be able to participate in a match with one of the 3 randomly generated rules.

[olist]
[*]     Accumulated Damage : Team with greater accumulated damage wins.
[*]     Beast Mode : Movement speed of all champions increases by 3. (including Ogre)
[*]     Quick Cast : Cooltime for all champion skills decreases by 80%.
[*]     Jab Jab : ATK of all champions decreases by 50% and ATK speed doubles.
[*]     Solid Blow : ATK speed of all champions decreases by 50% and ATK doubles.
[*]     Iron wall : DEF of all champions increases by 200.
[*]     00 ban : Cannot use 00 champions. (global ban on a specific category / ex. Warrior ban)
[*]     Reverse : Team with fewer kills wins
[*]     Contempt for Weaklings : All champions prioritize their attacks on enemies with low HP.
[*]     Speed Game : Game time: 30 sec, Respawn time: 1 sec
[/olist]

[h2]Changes and improvements[/h2]

- Archer’s Ultimate damage has been decreased.

- Archer’s ATK has been decreased.

- Berserker’s amount of lifesteal has been increased.

- Monk’s recovery coefficient has been increased.

- Monk’s HP has been increased.

- Cook’s ATK speed has been decreased.

- Cook’s skill cooltime has increased.

- Sniper’s ATK speed has been increased.

- Shadowmancer’s Ultimate stat increase amount has been increased.

- Shrine Maiden’s ATK damage and recovery coefficient have been increased.

- Poison Dart Hunter’s skill time has been decreased.

[h2]AI Ban&Pick[/h2]

- The AI on a normal difficulty has been changed to the one prior to the Patch 1.3.2. The new algorithm is applied after the New Game+ on a hard difficulty.

If you find any bugs, please don't hesitate to report them to [teamsamoyed@gmail.com].
We will fix them ASAP.

Thank you.

notes.title: 1.3 Patch Notes
notes.content:
[h1]New contents[/h1]

- Multiplayer feature has been added.
    - You can play 1v1 matches using ‘friendly match’.
    - Up to 10 players can play using ‘league’.

- Custom logo feature has been added.

- Feature has been added which allows you to change all team names and logos. Changed information can be applied at any time by saving and loading.

- Coach’s hairstyle has been added.

[h1]Changes and improvements[/h1]

- All team/sponsor names and logos have been changed.

- Names and images of some of the equipment have been changed.

- HP consumption of the Plague Doctor when using a skill has been decreased.

- Fighter's ATK has been decreased.

- Fighter's skill cooldown time has been decreased.

- Fighter's damage(skill) has been increased.

- Fighter's damage(Ultimate) has been increased.

- Clown’s ATK range has been increased.

- Clown's damage(Ultimate) has been increased.

- Exorcist's DEF and HP have been increased.

- Exorcist's skill cooldown time has been decreased.

- Exorcist's damage(Ultimate) has been increased.

- Executioner skill cooldown time has been decreased.

- Archer's damage(Ultimate) has been increased.

- Archer's ATK has been increased.

- Boomerang Hunter’s ATK has been increased.

- Boomerang Hunter's boomerang speed has been increased.

- Boomerang Hunter’s boomerang(skill) speed increased.

- Boomerang Hunter’s skill time has been decreased.

- Dual Blader's ATK has been increased.

- Cook's DEF has decreased, while HP has increased.

- Gambler’s damage(skill) has been decreased.

- Illusionist's ATK has been increased.

- Monk's skill has been changed from recovering himself&one ally to healing all nearby allies.

[h1]Bug fixed[/h1]

- A bug which allowed to ban&pick the opposing team’s champions when clicking out of turn was fixed.

We really wanted to implement the multiplayer spectator function, so we placed a TV in the waiting room and prepared a spectating UI, but it is technically impossible to implement because it was a feature that was not considered at the beginning of development. We apologize for making you feel bored during the multiplayer process.

If you happen to find any bugs in the game, please feel free to report them to [teamsamoyed@gmail.com]
We will fix them ASAP.

notes.title: 1.1 Patch note
notes.content:
Thank you for waiting. Teamfight Manager 1.1 is now available.

[h2]New contents[/h2]

- Weekly activity features added: when there are no scheduled matches, you may proceed with three types of weekly activities below.
[list]
[*]     Special training: you may enhance players' stats
[*]     Mental training: you may change players' traits
[*]     Streaming: you may secure funds
[/list]
- Strategy feature added: you may oder Ultimate timing, linked Ultimate, distance between allies through strategy execution.
- Facility upgrade item added: you may train new champions from the desired category using training by category.
- Incidents added
  [list]
[*]   Interview features added
[*]   Other feautres such as incidents that unexpectedly occur according to various circumstances have been added.
[/list]
- New game +: functions which allow you to set various game options added.
- New champions added: 5 new champions added
[list]
[*]     Lancer
[*]     Dual blader
[*]     Gambler
[*]     Executioner
[*]     Bard
[/list]

[h2]Language/OS support added[/h2]

- Chinese(simplified, traditional) language added
- Mac OS support added
- Russian language added

[h2]Changed items[/h2]

- Plague Doctor's Ultimate duration has been shortened.
- Changed so that Ultimate is used unsparingly, when under effect of Plague Doctor's Ultimate.
- Changed so that Vampire does not return to his coffin, when under effect of Plague Doctor's Ultimate.
- Swordsman's Ultimate damage has been increased.
- Swordsman's skill damage has been decreased.
- Monk's basic stats have been adjusted.
- DEF buff acquired by Knight when using skills has been decreased.
- Knight's skill range limit added
- Ghost's basic stats have been decreased.
- Pyromancer's basic attack coefficient has been adjusted.
- DEF and extra HP buff acquired by Devil when using Ultimate have been decreased.
- Boomerang Hunter's basic attack dealing more damage than intended was fixed.
- Lightning Mage's basic stats have been adjusted.
- Lightning Mage's Ultimate basic and AOE damage have been adjusted.
- Changed so that Lightning Mage's Ultimate is used against an enemy with the most HP.
- Berserker's extra stats acquired when using Ultimate have been lowered.
- Locker room conversation feature has been deleted.
- Changes in stats due to trait application can be seen during a match.
- Award Ceremony skip feature added
- Veteran player's basic stats have been decreased.
- Basic growth rate based on the player's potential has been adjusted.
- Stats growth rate due to invested training points has been increased.
- Skip feature of the story by clicking any button added
- Heart Breaker / Wise Leader challenge conditions have been changed.
[list]
[*]     Heart Breaker: Bring out players' negative response 30x during interviews.
[*]     Wise Leader: Bring out players' positive response 30x during interviews.
[/list]

[h2]Bugs fixed[/h2]

- A bug where Shield Bearer's Ultimate was being stopped by Devil's skill has been fixed.
- A bug where a champion's position would glitch when moving and levitating movements overlapped has been fixed.
- A bug where character's head, clothes' color, etc. appeared all black has been fixed.

If you happen to find any bugs in the game, please feel free to report them to teamsamoyed@gmail.com

We will fix them ASAP.
